messages:
ravi: quick sanity check — thinking of a proto-first internal gateway that exposes a lightweight policy DSL for routing + quota attribution. goal: let console show per-route cost/latency and let ops toggle canaries without touching client SDKs. thoughts?

mia: proto-first + gateway makes sense for typed contracts. curious about how the policy DSL looks — example? :thinking:

casey: high level +1. my worry: SDK consumers that are REST-only today. do we transcode at edge or force clients to upgrade?

ravi: transcode at edge is option A. option B is a thin proxy shim lib we can ship in clients. DSL sketch: `route {
  match: header("x-tenant"),
  policy: { prefer: model-v2, fallback: model-v1, quota: tenant_daily }
}` — console could render policy tree and toggle `prefer` -> `fallback` in rollout UX.

jen: that DSL looks fine. need telemetry hooks so console can show rollout delta (latency/cost/quality). propose we emit `policy.event` with `{route, decision, latency_ms, tokens}` to OTLP.

ops-ian: agree on telemetry. also need to ensure quota attribution works when we fanout - e.g., one client request -> multi model calls. we should attach `x-routing-decision` headers so we can stitch traces.

casey: stitching sounds solid. about REST clients: edge-transcode will add CPU on gateway. do we have perf numbers? infra-bot: perf-sim job queued — estimate ~6-8% p99 increase for simple transcoding on n1-standard; GPU-heavy paths unaffected.

mia: another UX ask: in console rollout UI, allow staged rollout by header claim (tenant id) + percentage. show expected QPS impact before applying change.

ravi: yep — rollout plan: (1) proto-first routes enabled for internal services only, (2) enable edge HTTP->gRPC transcoding for public REST clients, (3) expose rollout UI with canary by header and pct.

jen: one more: policy DSL should be versioned. we will want to validate changes with a dry-run mode that logs decisions but doesn't enforce. console can surface dry-run diffs.

ops-ian: for quotas, if we keep quota config in policy, we need a fast cache in gateway and fallback to centralized quota service on miss. otherwise latency spikes.

casey: +1 for cache. and add admin audit logs when someone toggles a policy via console. compliance will ask.

ravi: action items: 1) proto DSL RFC (i'll draft), 2) telemetry schema PR (jen), 3) perf sim + edge transcode numbers (infra-bot/ops-ian), 4) console mockups for rollout/dry-run (mia). i'll ping owners in this thread next week. :thumbsup:

sylvie: quick note — let's include test harness that can replay production traffic against policy dry-run to surface regressions in quality metrics. otherwise we might hide subtle output changes.

ravi: good call sylvie. adding to RFC. thanks everyone.
